summary: Enhancing Account Switcher Visibility and Accessibility
text: Redesigned the web account switcher as a dropdown from the top-right menu and from the name on the profile page, with scrolling past five accounts. Users can switch between their own, team member, parent or child company accounts from a dropdown on desktop and mobile web.

summary: Add region validation to backend
Admin logs. Add logs from clickhouse to admin panel
text: Replaced the admin logInfo page with a ClickHouse-backed admin action log, with event, date, controller and action filters, body search and XLS export. Admins can search and export a full log of admin actions, including who changed which setting and when, in the same design as the API logs page.

summary: Admin logs. Add new admin panel actions in admin logs
text: Added new admin panel actions to the admin logs. Admin logs cover the new admin panel.

summary: Add fields with errors highlighting in exhibitors categories settings
text: Highlighted fields with errors in exhibitor category settings using the errors returned by the API. Admins see which category settings fields are missing.

summary: Adding a customer service button to “...” actions in exhibitor/ visitor list
text: Added a 'Customer Service' action to the three-dots menu in the admin exhibitor and visitor lists, logging the admin in as that user. Admins open a user's frontend profile in a new tab directly from the list, with the login recorded in the login logs.

summary: Renaming settings in the Admin Panel
text: Renamed several Admin Panel settings from a supplied list and added a tooltip for Exhibitor Manual > Global Settings > Organizer Notifications. Confusing admin settings carry clearer names, and the organiser notifications field explains which emails or admins to enter.

summary: Adding Tool Tips in the Admin Panel
text: Added tooltips across Admin Panel modules from a supplied list, renamed one Management tooltip and fixed Chat Bot setting spellings. Admin Panel settings carry explanatory tooltips, and the Mobile app page has its own green tooltip style.

summary: Add intro copy to some Admin Portal pages
text: Added introductory copy, from a supplied list, to the top of several Admin Portal pages, replacing the Search page's 'Works only for ElasticSearch' note. Selected admin pages show a framed intro text explaining their purpose.

summary: Hide the Maintenance notification
text: Removed the Friday post-release maintenance warning and next-maintenance text from the RC admin and manager admin panels. Admin panels no longer show the maintenance warning, with no leftover space or broken UI.

summary: Replace 'Loading event data' with Loader in admin panel
text: Replaced the 'Loading event data' text with a loader in the admin panel. The admin panel shows a loader while event data loads.

summary: Remove redundant settings from the admin panel
text: Removed settings left over from the old UI from exhibitor and general admin settings. Admin settings pages are shorter.

summary: Create empty state for the tables in admin panel
text: Added an empty-state image to empty admin panel tables. Empty admin tables clearly show they have no data.

summary: Update the Save and similar buttons to the Primary type
text: Updated Save and similar buttons across the frontend to the Primary style and fixed static green buttons. Buttons follow the design system.

summary: [BE] Admin Panel: Organizer can click save/apply changes to Event configuration without page redirection so that work across entities is uninterrupted
text: Saving or applying changes across key Admin Panel modules no longer kicks organizers off the page, removing constant rework and navigation loss while they configure an event. Backend support so Save/Apply preserves the current view in Exhibitor Manual-Vendors, Marketing (News, Slugs, Campaigns) and the Mobile app builder.

summary: Client Manager: Show persistent banner in Admin Panel during event cloning to prevent changes
text: A persistent, non-blocking banner now warns admins not to edit an event while it is being cloned, eliminating a recurring source of data corruption. A fixed informational banner is shown across all Admin Panel module pages of the source event while cloning runs, telling users not to make changes until it completes.

summary: add validation to color picker
text: Added validation to the color picker so invalid color values can no longer be entered. Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

summary: Implementing Universal Pagination Memory in Admin Panel for User Experience Enhancement - Required List ONLY
text: Admin Panel lists remember each user's page, page size and sorting after a refresh or on returning, alongside the filters they already remembered. Organisers come back to exactly the view they left on participants, exhibitors, sessions and other lists.

summary: Standardising Pagination in the Admin Panel for Consistency and User Experience
text: Pagination across about 40 Admin Panel lists is standardised: always at the bottom, with the same design and page-size control. Organisers get the same pagination on every admin list, from participants and exhibitors to payments and check-in.

summary: Implementing Universal Pagination Memory in Admin Panel for User Experience Enhancement - Good To Have List ONLY
text: Admin Panel lists remember each user's page, page size and sorting after a refresh or on returning, alongside the filters they already remembered. Organisers come back to exactly the view they left on participants, exhibitors, sessions and other lists.

summary: Admin panel primary/secondary colors changes
Settings in old admin panel to apply in new admin pael
text: Made changes made in the old admin panel apply in the new admin panel. Both admin panels show the same settings.

summary: Add blure for bottom save/cancel bar
text: Gave the admin panel's bottom save and cancel bar a blurred background. The save bar matches the design.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Event Setup Page
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The Event Setup admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner, more contemporary interface with no change to existing functionality. New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Event Setup page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Categories Setup Page (Networking & Matchmaking)
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The Categories Setup admin page was restyled to the modern Untitled UI design via CSS only, with no functional changes. New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Categories Setup page with markup and PHP untouched, preserving category and networking/matchmaking configuration, and passing QA before release.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Exhibitor List Page
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The Exhibitor List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality. New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Exhibitor List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Participants List Page
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The Participants List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality. New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Participants List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Sessions List Page
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The Sessions List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality. New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Sessions List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

summary: [Admin Redesign] Event list
epic: Admin Panel CSS Redesign - Phase 1 (5 Core Pages)
text: The admin Event List page is being restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language as part of the Phase 1 admin redesign. Untitled UI CSS restyling of the Event List admin page, consistent with the other Phase 1 pages; specific details are not documented in the ticket.

summary: Admin panel rearangement. Move Sponsorship
text: Sponsorship becomes a top-level Admin Panel menu item right after Management, and a standalone module in Module Management. Organisers find sponsorship at the top level, with existing on/off states and functionality unchanged.

summary: Phone field for Admins
text: Added a phone field to admin profiles for use in campaign variables. Admin phone numbers can appear in emails.

summary: Regroup the structure of Config page of Sessions in Admin panel
text: Regrouped the Sessions Config admin page into separate Sessions, Exhibitor events and General settings columns. Each section shows only its own settings, with 'Allow other location' and 'Allow Address' for both and existing functions unchanged.

summary: Assigning Visitor/Exhibitor to Admin team
text: Added an Assigned Admin column, assign pop-up, filter and sorting to the admin Exhibitors and Participants lists, plus several list table tidy-ups. Each exhibitor or participant can have one assigned admin, shown in the list and usable to filter and sort; assignment is also available via API and export.

summary: Notification for Onboarding process
text: Added a web and app notification, sent 5 minutes after onboarding, saying the personalised recommendations page has been updated. Users who finish onboarding are notified and taken to their Recommendations page when they click.

summary: Onboarding Experience - Admin Panel & Web & App API
text: Built an admin onboarding configuration page with live preview, texts, category groups, mandatory or optional completion and reappearance timing, plus web and app APIs. Admins configure a multilingual onboarding flow that web and app users complete or skip, with skipped users prompted again after a set time.

summary: Onboarding Experience - App Part
text: Added the onboarding pop-up to the mobile app, asking participants to choose interest category groups on first login, as on the web. Participants select categories or skip (the pop-up returns after a set time unless mandatory), then see a customisable confirmation.

summary: Add error codes to front-end
Change text of error if there not enough symbols
text: Clarified the error message when a value has too few characters. Users see a clearer 'too short' message.

summary: Block <iframe> video until consent is given - Videos in EXH profile
text: Added a 'Participant Consent for iframe videos on exhibitor page' setting, off by default, that blocks exhibitor profile iframe videos until the user consents. When enabled, exhibitor profile videos stay blocked until one consent click, which then unlocks videos across the service.

summary: Switching Country Manager to external API Service
text: Switched the Country Manager to an external WikiData API for country, city and region names and translations, with monthly automatic updates. Country, city and region data is imported and refreshed monthly, and admins can edit names and translations without them being overwritten.

summary: Cancel Registration and Delete My Account Globally labels customization in the pop-ups
text: Applied custom Cancel registration and Delete my account labels to their confirmation popups. Popups use the customised labels.

summary: Custom Label changes
text: Built a Content Settings page for editing page and section labels per language, with All and Modified only tabs, applied on web and app. Organisers can rename labels such as sponsor, session and cancel-registration titles per language and see which were changed.

summary: Add timezone view in the admin panel to show selected TZ
text: Showed the saved time zone next to the event City setting, with a tooltip. Admins see the event time zone.

summary: Create an Event selection page for GDPR politics to delete accounts
text: Created a single event selection page where users can choose events and request deletion of their account data. One link opens a page listing all events, letting a verified user select events and delete their account and data from them.

summary: Correct naming of errors for inactive users (Web)
text: Replaced the login error for inactive users with 'Your account is inactive, please check your email and proceed with activation'. Inactive users trying to log in see one clear activation message across interfaces.

summary: Correct naming of errors for inactive users (App)
text: Set a common inactive-account login error, sent from the backend, and added a 'Resend activation link' button to the iOS and Android apps, including for OTP login. Inactive users in the apps see 'You haven't activated your account yet…' and can resend the activation email, which leads back to the app.

summary: Resend Activation Email for Inactive users in App
Improvement in the flow of Sending activation email at user level : WEB
text: Streamlined web login for inactive accounts: a 10-second notice with a 'Resend activation link' action, taking priority over a wrong password. Unactivated users resend the activation link straight from the login notice; unknown accounts still get 'Incorrect login/password'.

summary: "Resend activation link" for OTP
text: Added 'Resend activation link' to the one-time password flow for accounts that aren't activated. Unactivated users on OTP events can resend their activation email.

summary: Extend Page Opened on Login Functionality
text: Added a custom internal URL option to the 'page opened on login' settings for exhibitors, participants and team members. After login, users land on the admin-defined internal page, with required fields and onboarding still handled first.

summary: Add loaders to listing pages
text: Added loaders to listing pages that had none, such as marketplace, sessions, delegates, events and exhibitor lists. Listing pages show a loader while data loads.

summary: Add a loader to the session page when we click on a new date
text: Added a loader to the sessions page when a new date is picked. Users see loading feedback when switching dates.

summary: No local time option (Web)
text: Added a 'Do not show Local time on the Frontend (Web and App)' setting, off by default. When enabled, meetings, sessions, exhibitor events and blocked times show only event time on every frontend page.

summary: Date formats depend on locale
Add ability to use custom service on the newFront (login by token)
text: Switched customer service login to the new frontend using token login. Admins log in as users on the new frontend.

summary: Make hover color for buttons for sign in page
text: Added a hover color state to sign-in page buttons for visual consistency. A hover color was added to the sign-in page buttons.

summary: Remove Not a member? Sign up. line
text: Hid the 'Not a member? Sign up.' line in the login window when registration is off, for password and OTP login. Closed-registration events don't invite sign-ups.

summary: Make redirect after login on the server to the selected page
Login via badge scan
text: Added badge-scan login to the mobile app, with admin on/off and allowed-category settings and a configurable login button; the MVP covers the OTP flow. App users can log in by scanning their badge, activating the account if needed, with errors for unknown accounts or disallowed categories.

summary: Module management improvement
text: Restructured Global and Event Module Management toggles so every admin panel menu tab and sub-tab can be switched on or off. Module Management covers all admin sections, including a separate Networking & Matchmaking section and per-subtab Analytics toggles.

summary: Make redirects on tabs in analytics (/admin/stat/general) when permissions in module managment is turned off
Hide module Hospitality, Exhibitor info (manual), Taxes field for tables and Enable payment in Global settings
text: Hid the retired Hospitality module, table section tax fields and exhibitor manual payment setting. Admins no longer see retired settings.

summary: MFA | Admins
text: Added an MFA tab to admin accounts to enable authenticator-app login for admins, exclude chosen admins and send MFA setup emails. With MFA on, admins log in with password plus an authenticator code; excluded admins use password only; setup emails can be sent singly or in bulk.

summary: [adminv2] Add language selector on the login page
[adminv2] Choose language from storage on init
text: Made the new admin panel start in the language saved in local storage. The admin panel opens in the user's language.

summary: OTP Android: allow entering password code by copypasting
text: Allowed pasting the one-time password into the Android app's OTP field. Android users can paste the full OTP code.

summary: OTP improvement
text: Changed the OTP login flow so an OTP is emailed on request regardless of account status, and inactive users become active once logged in. On public events any user can request an OTP by email and log in, with inactive accounts activated on successful login.

summary: Independent OTP Authentication Configuration for Company and Individual Profiles in Events
text: OTP login can be switched on separately for individual profiles and company (exhibitor) profiles, via a single email-first login form. Attendees keep passwordless login while exhibitors can use a password; existing events keep OTP on for both.

feature: OTP login via WhatsApp and SMS
summary: OTP login workflow with Whatsapp/SMS
text: Extended OTP login so codes can be sent by WhatsApp and SMS as well as email, each enabled by its own toggle. Users receive OTPs through every enabled channel; SMS uses custom text and WhatsApp a preset template, both with login variables.

summary: Warning for Participant Category Change in Admin Panel
text: Added a confirmation warning in the old-UI admin panel when saving a participant profile with a changed category. Admins must confirm category changes after being told they may affect access, visibility, matchmaking and meeting eligibility.

summary: *DWTC* Indication of Fake Email
text: Added a warning icon to accounts using a generated fake email in the admin participants list and meeting wizard. Accounts with an @expoplatform.eu email are marked 'This account is using fake email.' in the participants list and meeting wizard.

summary: Indication of Email errors in admin panel
text: Added 'Empty email' and 'MX issue' warnings alongside the existing fake-email warning in the participants list and meeting wizard. Organisers see a warning mark with the error name for participants with no email or a broken MX configuration.

summary: Passwordless logination
text: Added passwordless one-time-password login on the front end, plus an admin-panel OTP button and an event setting to switch it on. Users log in with an emailed OTP valid for 3 minutes, with a 15-second resend cooldown; admins can generate and copy an OTP for any exhibitor or visitor.

summary: Hide Password reset window when OTP is turned on
text: Hid the password reset popup on first login when one-time password login is on. OTP events no longer prompt users to change a password.

summary: Cache for integrated Floorplan
Optimisation of the api/filters
text: Optimised the filters API used by the mobile apps, moving to the new filters and queued search syncing. Filter requests put much less load on the database.

summary: FloorPlan optimization
Optimization of Account Attribute Retrieval
text: Optimised account attribute retrieval to avoid per-account requests. Account data loads with far fewer requests.

summary: Optimize requests https://api-gitexplus.expoplatform.com/admin/appointments/tableMeetingsList
text: Optimised the admin table meetings list queries. The table meetings list loads faster.

summary: Implement caching of expo_config when using it from backend
text: Cached event config on the backend too, clearing it on each save. Backend reads of event config are cached.

summary: Optimization of front-end widgets related to search (exhibitors, products, brands)
Optimization of random card output in these widgets
The Sponsor page is loading slowly
text: Reworked the admin sponsor page to load faster. The sponsor page loads faster.

summary: Remove duplicated requests for banners, in case they are not added at all
text: Stopped the frontend from re-firing the same empty banner request on every navigation, cutting wasted API calls for placements with no banners configured. Empty-result caching stops re-requesting banners for empty placements within a session, while still picking up newly-added banners via TTL/reload, without affecting placements that do have banners.

summary: PG bouncer for production server
Improve relations between Module Management and Permission Matrix for meetings and messages
text: Moved meeting and message permissions from module management into the permission matrix, with a general Messages toggle. Organisers control meetings and messages in one place, with the matrix disabled when a module is off.

summary: Persistent Filter and Search Behavior for Visitor, Exhibitor, Sponsor, and Session lists
text: Made filters and search persist per admin on the admin sponsor, participant, exhibitor and session lists until 'Clear Filters' is used. Each admin's filters and search survive navigation, refresh and closing the page, without affecting other admins.

summary: Arabic language option
text: Added Arabic as a platform language, labelled 'AR' in the language list, using a supplied translation file. Events can offer Arabic ('AR') as a language.

summary: [portalUI] Add missed keys and languages to the project (IS)
text: Added missing translation keys and languages, including Icelandic, to the frontend. The frontend supports Icelandic and fills gaps in other languages.

summary: Translation: please apply the missing system translations
text: Applied missing and corrected German system translations in the basket, discount codes, registration and meeting request. German events show correct basket and meeting terms.

summary: Optimization of sync with elastic after event clone
text: Delayed search index syncing after an event clone until the clone has finished. Cloned events sync to search only once the clone is complete.

summary: Change sync of the whole event to bulk of Elasticsearch
text: Switched whole-event search syncing to the bulk API. Full event syncs to search run in bulk.

summary: Marketplace page requests optimization: re-organize request for Exhibitors in list-view.
text: Split the exhibitor search endpoint so categories and products load only in the marketplace list view. Marketplace exhibitor views load faster; list view requests full data.

summary: Include additional indexes
text: Added search indexes for participant company and job title and news author. Search finds participants by company and job title and news by author.

summary: Postgresql IndexPack04
text: Added PostgreSQL indexes on connections, product media, schedule contacts, admin access and template modules. Common queries run faster.

summary: [Expo-react-components]: optimization for MultiSelect with a lof of options (virtualization, load on scroll, load on search ... )
Add caching of data from geoapify.com
Reduce number of requests from app to server
text: Reduced app requests for recommendation IDs, filters and onboarding settings with debouncing and conditions. The apps send far fewer of these requests.

summary: Optimize response data for delegate search
text: Optimised the response data for delegate search. Delegate search responses are lighter.

summary: Reduce db_route connection usage in expoplatform-ws-ValidateUser Lambda
text: Added a per-Lambda cache for routing data in ValidateUser, cutting database connections and reducing RDS exhaustion risk under load. The Lambda now caches db_route data per warm container with a configurable TTL, falling back to the database only when the cache is empty or expired, with no functional change to routing behavior.

summary: [next14] turn off request to /auth when token in nulll
text: Stopped the server from making an unnecessary auth request when there is no token, cutting wasted server-side calls. Server no longer issues the /auth request when the token is null.

summary: replace barrel imports with deep imports for MUI and expo-react-components
text: Barrel imports across ~2,600 files are converted to deep imports and guarded by a lint rule, improving bundle size and dev build speed. Barrel imports are codemod-converted to deep imports, a `no-restricted-imports` ESLint rule is added to prevent regressions, and the convention doc is ported into admin-ui.

summary: Optimization next14
text: Applied performance optimizations to the Next14 frontend; the ticket does not specify which metrics or areas. Performance optimizations were applied to the Next14 frontend, per the ticket title.

summary: manifest.webmanifest is re-fetched on every App Router navigation (max-age=0, no ETag)
text: Fixed the web app manifest to cache for an hour like the site's icons, eliminating a needless full network round-trip on every single page navigation. Replaced the Next.js file-convention manifest with a custom route handler serving the same manifest JSON with the same hour-long cache policy as the icons, verified to produce zero repeat network requests within the cache window.

summary: request sized WebP variants instead of original images across portal-ui
text: Makes portal-ui request sized WebP image variants instead of original uploads, cutting image traffic and CloudFront cost. The frontend requests sized WebP variants through the existing resize lambda; done.

summary: Enhancing Privacy for Opted-Out Users: Favouriting Features and GDPR Compliance
text: Opted-out attendees can favourite users, exhibitors and products privately; these favourites never expose them, count as leads or appear in the API. Favouriting works for everyone on web and app; counters note they may include anonymous favourites, and privacy holds if users later opt in.

summary: Mobile app: allow opted-out users to favourite exhibitors, visitors and products
text: Opted-out users can now favourite and unfavourite exhibitors, visitors and products in the mobile app, privately, as they already could on web. The favourite affordance shows for opted-out users on all three surfaces, stored privately so the other party is never identified; done.

summary: Participant Profile Completion Calculation Update
text: Participant profile completion counts only the fields a participant can see and edit, each weighted equally, including photo. Fields that are hidden by conditions, not editable or disabled no longer drag down completion.

summary: Admin panel. Profile completition in Participants list
text: A sortable Profile completion column in the Admin Panel participants list, matching the frontend value, with a recalculate button. Organisers sort participants by profile completion and refresh values after imports or bulk changes.

summary: Dynamic Edit Profile Labels
text: Made the profile edit page title dynamic: 'Edit Company profile' for exhibitors and 'Edit Personal profile' for all personal accounts, including admins. Users see a profile edit page title that matches their account type.

summary: Detach public pages from content preview | Require Login Setting
text: Tied access to public File pages to the exhibitor sign-in access setting instead of the content-preview login toggle. File and exhibitor pages are open without login under Open access and require login under Sign in only, whatever the preview toggle.

summary: Create aws resources on australia
text: Created AWS resources in the Australia region: queues, DynamoDB tables and log groups. The platform can run in an Australian region.

summary: The exhibitor registration reCapthca
text: Added reCAPTCHA as a mandatory step in frontend exhibitor registration. Exhibitor registration includes reCAPTCHA, protecting the form from spam submissions.

summary: re work exports to new schema with statuses
epic: Each task runned via workers should return an status
text: Reworked exports to a status-controlled schema that automatically reruns an incompletely processed batch up to 3 times. Exports look and behave the same but recover from transient glitches instead of hanging.

summary: Exhibitor Manual export rework
text: Reworked the Exhibitor Manual export to run through SQS. Admins download the Exhibitor Manual report via a queued job, with all respective information present in the file.

summary: Add "remove styling" button for TextEditor
text: Added a 'remove styling' button to the text editor. Admins can strip pasted styles.

summary: Add search function to data fields
text: Added live search to all select-type profile fields: Country, City, State/Region, Nationality and custom Select, including multiselect. Typing in a select field filters options by any case-insensitive match and shows 'No results found' when nothing matches.

summary: Web secure fixes
text: Fixed security issues in the frontend, admin panel and server listed in a security report supplied by a client. The reported security issues across frontend, admin panel and server were addressed.

summary: Applications secure fixes
text: Fixed security issues in the Android and iOS apps listed in a security report supplied by a client. The reported security issues in the Android and iOS apps were addressed.

summary: Add account_id to activation_code hash generation
text: Added the account ID to activation code hash generation. Activation codes are unique per account.

summary: Add secure token to scanBadge endpoint
text: Added an HMAC security token header to the app's badge scan endpoint. Badge scan requests are signed.

summary: Remove token and id from request
text: Removed token and ID parameters from the regular app's visitors requests. Visitor requests are lighter.

summary: XSS in places where HTML should work
Add rate limiting to /api/v1/resend endpoint
text: Added rate limiting to /api/v1/resend after a real attack sent 1,116 requests in 15 minutes to flood participant inboxes. The endpoint now allows 5 requests per minute per IP, blocks abusive IPs for 5 minutes with a 429 response, while legitimate single requests keep working.

summary: Meet API Standards for api/v1/schedule/note
text: Closed data-leakage and auth-bypass gaps in the schedule/note API, removing internal server details from error responses. Removed sensitive data leakage from error responses and an undocumented internal IP field, enforced auth-token validation and input bounds; API contract alignment work continuing.

summary: Extend Event Cloning to Support Selective Cloning of Sponsors, News, Sessions, Local Categories, and Floor Plan
text: Organizers can now choose exactly which content categories carry over when cloning an event, eliminating up to two days of manual cleanup. The clone dialog now offers independent checkboxes per content category with a confirmation summary, so only selected data is copied and manual post-clone cleanup is removed.

summary: Customize entire error page for non existing records which try to login via SAML SSO   - configure through web builder
text: Added a 'Use as error page' toggle to custom website builder pages for SAML SSO users not found on the event. Clients design their own error page for SSO users validated by the IdP but missing from EP or the event.

summary: Remove log in pop up  - Web Only
text: Replaced the web login pop-up for SAML SSO with an in-tab login that returns users to the page or action that required sign-in. SSO users sign in within the same tab, land back where they started, and skip login when already authenticated at the IdP.

summary: IMEX - SAML User is always directed to Event homepage and not intended page invoking the process
text: Added a SAML settings trigger to return users to the page they originally requested after authenticating. With the trigger on, users land on their intended page after SAML authentication; other clients' behaviour is unchanged.

summary: Separate login buttons
text: Login now offers two clear paths, SAML SSO for buyers and standard EP login for API-created team members, so both can authenticate. A sign-in modal now offers two options: SAML redirect to the identity provider, or the standard EP login flow.

summary: Adding additional login option on mobile app
text: Adding a configurable second external login button to the mobile app lets a client offer attendees an alternate webview-based sign-in path, satisfying a specific customer requirement. A second external login button was added to the native login screen (type 'Both'), opening the existing webview login flow with configurable label/colour, plus new App Builder/API settings to control it.

summary: Whitelist Trusted Embed Domains for Authenticated Iframe Content
text: Organizers can now whitelist trusted external domains so authenticated content, like On-Demand Sessions, plays correctly when embedded on partner sites. A new 'Security settings / Trusted embed domains' section in Event Setup lets organizers add and remove whitelisted domains; for those origins the auth cookie is issued SameSite=None; Secure so embedded authenticated Sessions play seamlessly.

summary: [portalUI] add loader to the buttons with downloading files in the user profile
text: Added loaders to the download buttons for scanned contacts in the user menu. Users see progress on lead downloads.
